biography.plain_text: Harry M. “Sonny” Berry III is an American aviation entrepreneur who founded Berry Aviation in Austin in 1983. He developed the business from charter flying into government airlift, on-demand cargo, maintenance, parts distribution and fixed-base operations. The 2018 sale to Acorn Growth Companies concluded thirty-five years of continuous founder leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Charter assignments initially helped Sonny Berry cover the cost of operating a twin-engined aircraft. He turned that practical arrangement into a company in the Texas capital in 1983. Defence approval opened international government work, and relocation to San Marcos Regional Airport supplied a permanent base. The operation broadened across urgent freight, aircraft maintenance, parts distribution and airport services.

Outside capital supported a minority recapitalisation while Berry remained chairman, president and chief executive. Acorn's 2018 acquisition closed a 35-year period of founder leadership. By the end of his tenure, the company combined worldwide government missions with commercial cargo and technical support from its Texas base.
